Name: StarDewYouTubeChat
Author: Tine2548
Description:
[b]This mod use for connect to your YouTube live caht and read chat in game.

How to use:
[list=1]
[*][b]place client_secret.json from [url=https://console.cloud.google.com/]Google Cloud Console[/url]﻿ in \Mods\StarDewYTChat\assets.[/b]
[*][b]place YouTubeAPI key from [url=https://console.cloud.google.com/]Google Cloud Console[/url]﻿ in \Mods\StarDewYTChat\config.json[/b]
[*][b]place LiveId from your live stream in \Mods\StarDewYTChat\config.json[/b]
[*][b]press O for Authorization and Clear Authorize.[/b]
[*][b]press P for Start and Stop Chat.[/b]
[/list][/b]
